title: Feature Selection Methodology
description: Selection of minimal, highly predictive feature subsets to prevent curse of dimensionality and overfitting.
conditions: High ratio of features to observations (P / N > 0.1)
Presence of uninformative, noisy, or redundant predictors
Requirement to improve model inference speed and interpretability
recommended_methods: Mutual Information regression/classification for non-linear dependency screening
Permutation Feature Importance evaluated on held-out validation data
selection_rules: Never rely on Gini impurity importance from default Random Forest as it heavily biases toward high-cardinality features
Compute Permutation Importance on validation set to measure true generalization degradation
Drop zero-variance and quasi-constant features (variance < 1e-4) before running wrapper selection
limitations: Wrapper methods like RFECV are computationally expensive on large feature sets
Features that appear uninformative in univariate filters may have powerful non-linear interaction effects
